# uptimeeye_scheduled_task (Resource)

A scheduled task (heartbeat/cron monitoring) expects periodic pings from your jobs and alerts through a notification channel when a ping is missed. Exactly one of `cron_task` or `simple_task` must be configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cron-based heartbeat: alerts when the job does not check in on schedule.
resource "uptimeeye_scheduled_task" "nightly_backup" {
  name                    = "Nightly backup"
  notification_channel_id = uptimeeye_notification_channel.oncall.id
  grace_period            = 30

  cron_task = {
    cron_expression = "0 3 * * *"
    timezone        = "Europe/Berlin"
  }
}

# Interval-based heartbeat.
resource "uptimeeye_scheduled_task" "queue_worker" {
  name                    = "Queue worker"
  notification_channel_id = uptimeeye_notification_channel.oncall.id
  grace_period            = 5

  simple_task = {
    interval_type  = "minutes"
    interval_value = 15
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grace_period` (Number) Grace period in minutes before a missed ping triggers an alert.
- `name` (String) Display name of the scheduled task.
- `notification_channel_id` (String) ID of the notification channel to alert when the task misses its schedule.

### Optional

- `cron_task` (Attributes) Cron-based schedule. Conflicts with `simple_task`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cron_task))
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether monitoring of this task is paused.
- `simple_task` (Attributes) Fixed-interval schedule. Conflicts with `cron_task`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--simple_task))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for organizing scheduled tasks.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Scheduled task identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--cron_task"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cron_task`

Required:

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression defining when pings are expected.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the cron expression is evaluated in.


<a id="nestedatt--simple_task"></a>
### Nested Schema for `simple_task`

Required:

- `interval_type` (String) Unit of the interval. One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`.
- `interval_value` (Number) Expected time between pings, in units of `interval_type`.
